description: P15.03: disabled graph-authored curriculum from verified counterexamples, frozen training residuals, contested acquired distinctions and fresh-task stale-strategy rechecks.

microtheory.name: process_curriculum
microtheory.description: Fund at most one bounded training task at a time from source- and epoch-bound residual evidence.

rules.name: pc_capture_observed_process_counterexample_residual
rules.comment: A source- and epoch-bound observed counterexample creates a training task with the answer withheld.

rules.name: pc_capture_frozen_training_representation_residual
rules.comment: Only verified frozen-training residual bits can seed representation curriculum; held-out outcomes are not copied.

rules.name: pc_capture_contested_acquired_distinction
rules.comment: Contested acquired dimensions generate fresh evidence tasks scoped to the exact owner and model/frame epochs.

rules.name: pc_schedule_stale_strategy_on_fresh_matching_task
rules.comment: Recheck an old success only on a new active task with matching structure and the current domain epochs.

rules.name: pc_fund_one_ranked_training_residual
rules.comment: Fund one verified training residual at a time using the configured native selector and shared ThinkingBudget.

rules.name: pc_emit_training_task_only_after_budget_approval
rules.comment: Emit only a training-split task after approval and omit answers, held-out identifiers and labels.

rules.name: pc_close_curriculum_task_on_observed_progress
rules.comment: Only a same-epoch observed experience outcome closes a curriculum task as completed.

rules.name: pc_retire_unlearnable_task_without_repetition
rules.comment: An observed unlearnable assessment is terminal for this exact residual key; later epochs need new evidence keys.

rules.name: pc_mark_expired_residual_stale_without_retry
rules.comment: Epoch mismatch or expired task ends this attempt; it cannot be mistaken for progress or retried from stale evidence.

rules.name: pc_close_denied_curriculum_request_without_retry
rules.comment: Denied funding suppresses this evidence key and never creates an unfunded training task.
